context: Friday evening. Mei and Ren on their couch, side by side, neither doing anything in particular.
purpose: quiet intimacy — the relief of doing nothing together

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Voice settles deeper into the couch. A full, honest release without drama. Slight breathiness on the opening word.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Soft, genuinely curious — not probing. Eyes already turning toward her. Bare simplicity of the question, voice steady.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 何もない日だったから、余計に。
lines.en: That's just it — nothing happened. That's what wears you down.
lines.style: A small, knowing laugh underneath the words. The tone of someone recognising an uncomfortable truth about themselves.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: Yeah, I know what you mean.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. No rushing to fix or change anything. Just settling into the weight alongside her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 本当に何もしたくない。一緒にいてくれるだけでいい。
lines.en: I don't want to do anything. Just you being here — that's enough.
lines.style: Soft and unguarded, no performance. The final phrase lands with quiet certainty, tender but real.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いるよ。時間あるし、今日はもう何も予定ない。
lines.en: I'm here. I've got all the time you need — nothing else tonight.
lines.style: Steady, grounding presence in every syllable. Simple and direct affection, no embellishment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ありがとう。…大丈夫になってきた。
lines.style: A slow, complete exhale before the final phrase. Quiet return to stillness. Recovery arriving without fanfare.
